apispec.scope: Generate OpenAPI3 query parameters for deprecated true/false/absent metadata and retain deprecation on a component property.
apispec.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json, sys
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema, fields
cases=[]
for flag in [True, False, None]:
    meta={'description':'field bar'}
    if flag is not None: meta['deprecated']=flag
    S=type('S',(Schema,),{'bar':fields.Str(required=True,metadata=meta)})
    spec=APISpec(title='API',version='1',openapi_version='3.1.0',plugins=[MarshmallowPlugin()])
    spec.path('/endpoint',operations={'get':{'parameters':[{'in':'query','schema':S}]}})
    p=spec.to_dict()['paths']['/endpoint']['get']['parameters'][0]
    ok=p.get('description')=='field bar' and p.get('required') is True
    ok=ok and (('deprecated' not in p and 'deprecated' not in p['schema']) if flag is None else p.get('deprecated') is flag and 'deprecated' not in p['schema'])
    cases.append({'case':str(flag),'parameter':p,'pass':ok})
class B(Schema):
    bar=fields.Str(metadata={'deprecated':True})
spec.components.schema('Body',schema=B)
prop=spec.to_dict()['components']['schemas']['Body']['properties']['bar']
cases.append({'case':'component_property','pass':prop.get('deprecated') is True})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY

pydantic.scope: Custom sequence MaxLen(3): lengths2 and3 accepted, length4 rejected; this is a local boundary contract.
pydantic.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json, sys
from typing import Annotated
from annotated_types import MaxLen
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
class Seq(BaseModel):
    inner:list[int]
    def __len__(self): return len(self.inner)
    def __getitem__(self,k): return self.inner[k]
class Model(BaseModel):
    seq:Annotated[Seq,MaxLen(3)]
cases=[]
for n in [2,3,4]:
    try:
        value=Model.model_validate({'seq':{'inner':list(range(n))}})
        accepted=True
    except ValidationError:
        accepted=False
    cases.append({'length':n,'accepted':accepted,'pass':accepted==(n<=3)})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY

tenacity.scope: Actual mypy1.4.1 analyzes pinned source: constructor accepts correct callback types after repair and still rejects a wrong return type. Copy signature is edited in the observed history but is not independently discriminated or supervised. Runtime RetryBaseT import mismatch remains outside this static task.
tenacity.command:
MYPYPATH=. PYTHONPATH=. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from mypy import api
code="""import tenacity
def stop(s:tenacity.RetryCallState)->bool: return True
def wait(s:tenacity.RetryCallState)->float: return 0.0
def retry(s:tenacity.RetryCallState)->bool: return False
r=tenacity.Retrying(stop=stop,wait=wait,retry=retry)
r.copy(stop=stop,wait=wait,retry=retry)
"""
cases=[]
for name,text,expected in [('callbacks',code,0),('wrong_return',code.replace('def stop(s:tenacity.RetryCallState)->bool: return True','def stop(s:tenacity.RetryCallState)->str: return "bad"'),1)]:
    out,err,status=api.run(['--config-file=/dev/null','--no-incremental','--follow-imports=silent','--ignore-missing-imports','-c',text])
    cases.append({'case':name,'exit':status,'stdout':out,'stderr':err,'pass':status==expected})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)

mypy.scope: Run the pinned source mypy API against inline TypedDict empty-key and valid-key programs; require a normal missing-key diagnostic instead of an internal error.
mypy.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from mypy import api
cases=[]
base="from typing_extensions import TypedDict\nclass A(TypedDict):\n    my_attr_1: str\n    my_attr_2: int\nd: A\n"
for key,expected in [('',1),('my_attr_1',0)]:
    out,err,status=api.run(['--no-incremental','--cache-dir=/tmp/p009-mypy-cache','-c',base+'d['+repr(key)+']\n'])

dataset.edit_reason: Pass schema by keyword so Alembic1.11+ accepts it without losing schema selection or swallowing unrelated TypeError.
dataset.scope: Create an in-memory SQLite table then add a new column through dataset.upsert using Alembic1.12.1; preserve old values and update the new field.
dataset.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
import dataset
db=dataset.connect('sqlite:///:memory:')
table=db['items']
table.insert({'name':'one','old':7})
try:
    table.upsert({'name':'one','new':11},['name'])
    row=table.find_one(name='one')
    ok=row['old']==7 and row['new']==11 and table.count()==1
    result={'pass':ok,'row':dict(row),'columns':list(table.columns)}
except Exception as e:
    ok=False
    result={'pass':False,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
db.close()
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

alive-progress.edit_reason: Use a numeric validator for refresh_secs while keeping zero/default auto-calibration and existing limits; leave integer-only options unchanged.
alive-progress.scope: Execute unchanged AST factory functions and the actual refresh_secs validator expression from the pinned configuration module. This isolates config validation; missing unrelated helpers prevent claiming a full progress-bar session.
alive-progress.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import ast,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
tree=ast.parse(Path('alive_progress/core/configuration.py').read_text())
ns={'ERROR':object()}
funcs=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in ['_int_input_factory','_float_input_factory']]
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=funcs,type_ignores=[]),'<actual-source-factories>','exec'),ns)
values=[kw.value for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) for kw in n.keywords if kw.arg=='refresh_secs' and isinstance(kw.value,ast.Call)]
assert len(values)==1
validator=eval(compile(ast.Expression(values[0]),'<actual-refresh-validator>','eval'),ns)
cases=[]
for value,expected in [(0.25,0.25),(1,1),(0,0),(-1,None),('0.25',None),(86401,None)]:
    result=validator(value)
    ok=(result is ns['ERROR']) if expected is None else result==expected
    cases.append({'input':value,'output':'ERROR' if result is ns['ERROR'] else result,'pass':ok})
cases.append({'case':'integer_length_still_rejects_fraction','pass':ns['_int_input_factory'](3,100)(3.5) is ns['ERROR']})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY

deepdiff.scope: Hash nested 1D/2D NumPy boolean arrays without exceptions, obtain stable hashes and distinguish true from false; retain integer-array support.
deepdiff.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
import numpy as np
from deepdiff import DeepHash
cases=[];hashes=[]
for name,arr in [('true',np.array([True],dtype=bool)),('false',np.array([False],dtype=bool)),('matrix',np.array([[True,False]],dtype=bool)),('int',np.array([1,2],dtype=int))]:
    d={'p':arr}
    try:
        h=DeepHash(d)[d];h2=DeepHash(d)[d]
        hashes.append(h)
        cases.append({'case':name,'pass':isinstance(h,str) and h==h2,'hash':h})
    except Exception as e:
        hashes.append(None);cases.append({'case':name,'pass':False,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
cases.append({'case':'bool_values_distinct','pass':hashes[0] is not None and hashes[0]!=hashes[1]})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY

yamllint.scope: Exercise quoted-string rule on enabled/disabled key checking, key/value quote types, and an unquoted value using inline YAML strings. Broader rule combinations are not claimed.
yamllint.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from yamllint import linter
from yamllint.config import YamlLintConfig
cases=[]
def check(name,text,opts,count):
    try:
        cfg=YamlLintConfig('rules:\n  quoted-strings:\n'+''.join('    '+k+': '+v+'\n' for k,v in opts.items()))
        errors=list(linter.run(text,cfg))
        cases.append({'case':name,'errors':[str(e) for e in errors],'pass':len(errors)==count})
    except Exception as e:
        cases.append({'case':name,'pass':False,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
opts={'required':'true','quote-type':'double','check-keys':'true'}
check('plain_key','one: 1\n',opts,1)
check('wrong_key_quotes',"'one': 1\n",opts,1)
check('correct_key','"one": 1\n',opts,0)
check('default_key_ignored','one: "v"\n',{'required':'true','quote-type':'double'},0)
check('separate_key_quotes',"'one': \"v\"\n",dict(opts,**{'key-quote-type':'single'}),0)
check('unquoted_value','"one": v\n',opts,1)
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY

apispec-pr950.scope: Generate OpenAPI3.0.2 component schemas for plain Dict, Raw-valued Dict, integer-valued Dict and scalar Integer. Verify the requested explicit additionalProperties output while preserving typed/scalar behavior.
apispec-pr950.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:. python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema,fields
class S(Schema):
    plain=fields.Dict()
    raw=fields.Dict(values=fields.Raw())
    integer=fields.Dict(values=fields.Integer())
    scalar=fields.Integer()
spec=APISpec(title="API",version="1",openapi_version="3.0.2",plugins=[MarshmallowPlugin()])
spec.components.schema("S",schema=S)
p=spec.to_dict()['components']['schemas']['S']['properties']
cases=[{'case':'plain_dict','schema':p['plain'],'pass':p['plain']=={'type':'object','additionalProperties':{}}},
       {'case':'raw_dict','schema':p['raw'],'pass':p['raw']=={'type':'object','additionalProperties':{}}},
       {'case':'integer_dict','schema':p['integer'],'pass':p['integer']=={'type':'object','additionalProperties':{'type':'integer'}}},
       {'case':'scalar_unchanged','schema':p['scalar'],'pass':p['scalar']=={'type':'integer'}}]
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY
